meaning: to think up, come up with

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for inventing or devising an idea, method, or plan.

exampleSentences.english: I finally contrive a simple way to solve this problem.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我終於諗出一個簡單方法，解決呢個問題。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 nam2 ceot1 jat1 go3 gaan2 daan1 fong1 faat3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4

english.note: Use this when the invention is a new method, idea, or approach that someone thinks up.

exampleSentences.english: We invent a new way to solve this problem.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋諗出一個新方法去解決呢個問題。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 nam2 ceot1 jat1 go3 san1 fong1 faat3 heoi3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4

english.note: Use this when someone works out or comes up with a plan, idea, or solution.

exampleSentences.english: We often evolve good solutions by talking things through together.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋一齊傾吓，通常都諗出到好辦法。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 king1 haa5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 nam2 ceot1 dou3 hou2 baan6 faat3
